title: repeat_labels
description: What the confirmer returns for the pairs of claims it was shown (Implementation Decision 17; ticket 95): each pair, by its number, labelled the same claim, contradicting, or different. For a pair that is the same, the text a merge would keep: the first or the second occurrence verbatim, or one sentence combined from both. A pair kept apart may carry a flag that lists it for the grill.

pair.description: the pair's number in the prompt

kept.description: on a pair that is the same: the occurrence a merge keeps verbatim (the fuller one), or combined; null otherwise

text.description: the combined sentence when kept is combined, with no provenance tag; null otherwise

flag.description: list the pair for the grill: different but close enough that the owner should see them side by side
